description:
- Design, develop and maintain scalable data architectures and data pipelines supporting manufacturing applications and analytics.
- Integrate data from multiple operational systems and IIoT sources to improve data accessibility and reliability.
- Analyze large datasets and leverage advanced analytics and machine learning to generate actionable insights.
- Develop ad-hoc visualizations and dashboards to support operational improvements and business decisions.
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate IIoT devices and sensors into existing infrastructure.
- Implement monitoring and reporting solutions to track system and manufacturing performance.
- Work closely with IT, Operations and business stakeholders to gather requirements and translate business needs into technical solutions.
- Ensure data governance, security and compliance requirements are properly maintained.
